meta.title: Performance Optimization: Fix N+1 Database Queries in Search API
meta.body_summary: Fix N+1 database query pattern in search API by merging two prisma.repo.findMany() calls into one OR query, with a supporting PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md.

perf_labels.notes: Devin merged two findMany queries into one OR query with narrative 50% claim; no human review, auto-closed after 7+ days inactivity.

core_change_summary.description: In searchApi.ts, combined two separate prisma.repo.findMany() calls (one by numeric IDs, one by string names) into a single query with an OR condition, reducing database round trips. Added PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md documenting other performance opportunities.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The performance report adds documentation but no executable benchmarks.
